description: NaTiAsO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.73 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 34°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.08 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-56°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.73 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one As atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂TiAs tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
